about.title: About me
about.section_1: Welcome! My name is Magdolna Kozma, and I have been a supporter of a healthy lifestyle for decades, both for myself and for my loved ones. Since childhood, I have been introduced to the world of traditional remedies and the self-healing opportunities offered by nature, which I have been practicing ever since. This knowledge is deeply rooted in me, intertwining closely with my everyday life.
about.section_2: I chose the physical and well-being improving therapies listed on my website and immersed myself in them because I am passionately interested in health. I want to help others understand how to improve their health by combining traditional methods with modern technological tools.
